title: A Five-Plane Reference Architecture for Runtime Governance of Production AI Agents
title_zh: 面向生产级 AI Agent 运行时治理的五平面参考架构
abstract_en: Enterprise security was built to govern data boundaries: the protected surface was data at rest and in transit, and the controls -- access control, data-loss prevention, perimeter inspection -- governed crossings of that boundary. Production AI agents dissolve this assumption. An agent reads context, calls tools, invokes connectors, and modifies systems of record on an enterprise's behalf, so risk moves inside the workflow, into sequences of individually-permitted actions that may transform a business process no one authorized. Existing policy engines do not extend to this regime: they evaluate request-time decisions against atomic principals, where agentic systems require stateful evaluation against composite principals whose authority attenuates through delegation chains. We present a reference architecture for the runtime governance of production agents, built from four composable primitives: a five-plane decomposition (a reasoning plane that adjudicates intent, and four enforcement planes -- network, identity, endpoint, data -- that realize the decision), stop-anywhere mediation, composite principals with capability attenuation, and audit as a structured evidence substrate. We define a taxonomy of six interruption primitives that generalize allow and deny, state and argue for four correctness invariants, and demonstrate the foreclosure of seven production-agent threats across five concrete workflows. A reference implementation of the policy-engine core supplies measured evidence: attenuation correctness and evidence reconstructability hold on every trial, adjudication runs in single-digit microseconds, and the audit substrate's tamper-evidence behaves exactly as designed. We are explicit about scope: the architecture governs delegated action, not model behavior, and a full-system evaluation against a live agent benchmark is the invited next step.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于生产级 AI Agent 运行时治理的参考架构。传统企业安全主要围绕数据边界设计，关注静态数据与传输中数据，并通过访问控制、数据防泄漏和边界检查等机制治理跨边界行为。然而，AI Agent 会读取上下文、调用工具、连接外部系统并代表企业修改记录系统，使风险从边界转移到工作流内部：一系列单独被允许的操作可能组合成未经授权的业务流程。现有策略引擎通常基于原子主体在请求时做无状态决策，难以处理 Agent 系统中具有委托链、权限衰减和组合主体的有状态治理需求。论文提出四个可组合原语：五平面分解，包括负责意图裁决的 reasoning plane，以及执行决策的 network、identity、endpoint、data 四个 enforcement planes；stop-anywhere mediation；带能力衰减的 composite principals；以及作为结构化证据基底的 audit。作者定义了六类 interruption primitives，推广传统 allow/deny，提出四个正确性不变量，并在五个具体工作流中展示其可阻断七类生产 Agent 威胁。参考实现聚焦 policy-engine core，微基准结果显示权限衰减正确性与证据可重构性在所有试验中成立，裁决延迟为个位数微秒，审计基底的防篡改行为符合设计。论文明确其范围是治理被委托的行动，而非模型行为；基于真实 Agent benchmark 的全系统评估被列为未来工作。
key_points_zh: 提出面向生产 AI Agent 的 runtime governance 参考架构，核心问题是治理工作流内部由多步合法动作组合出的越权风险，而非仅治理传统数据边界。
架构包含 reasoning plane 与 network、identity、endpoint、data 四个 enforcement planes，并通过 stop-anywhere mediation 在任意关键环节中断、审查或限制 Agent 行动。
引入 composite principals 与 capability attenuation，用于描述人、Agent、工具、连接器等组合主体在委托链中的权限传递与衰减。
将 audit 设计为结构化证据基底，支持事后重构决策过程，并提供防篡改证据；参考实现验证了 evidence reconstructability 与 attenuation correctness。
实验主要是 policy-engine core 的微基准：裁决延迟达到个位数微秒；论文尚未完成面向真实 Agent benchmark 的全系统评估。

llm_assessment.comment: A highly relevant reference architecture for production agent governance with stateful mediation, capability attenuation, audit evidence, and concrete enforcement planes.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项高度相关的生产智能体治理参考架构工作，涵盖状态化中介、能力衰减、审计证据和具体执行平面。
